# dnsgate_record_set (Data Source)

One RRset of a zone served by the gate, whoever owns it. Fails if it does not exist.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dnsgate_record_set" "mx" {
  zone = "example.com"
  name = "@"
  type = "MX"
}

output "mx_owner" {
  value = data.dnsgate_record_set.mx.owner
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name relative to the zone, `@` for the apex.
- `type` (String)
- `zone` (String)

### Read-Only

- `alias` (Attributes) Alias target, null for records with values. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--alias))
- `hash` (String) Content hash (the ETag of the RRset).
- `id` (String) `<zone>/<name>/<type>`.
- `owner` (String)
- `protected` (Boolean)
- `status` (String)
- `ttl` (Number) Null for aliases.
- `values` (Set of String) Values as the gate stores them.

<a id="nestedatt--alias"></a>
### Nested Schema for `alias`

Read-Only:

- `evaluate_target_health` (Boolean)
- `name` (String)
- `zone_id` (String)
